'''Apokan silveroak''' was a type of wood from the [[Apoka system/Legends|Apoka system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the interior of the [[Peregrine-class star yacht|''Peregrine''-class star yacht]] [[Thief's Eye/Legends|''Thief's Eye'']] was furnished with Apokan silveroak.
